name: CVE Program partners (CNAs and roots)
memberRule: An organization in the partner list of the CVE Program, as the cve.org website data file lists it.
note: Each partner publishes its CVE records in the CVE List, so the record of cvelistV5 reads them all. Many partners also publish their own advisories.

name: OSV.dev ecosystems
memberRule: An ecosystem name in the ecosystems.txt file of the OSV.dev data bucket.
note: Each ecosystem is one package registry or one distribution. The data bucket of OSV.dev holds the records of each ecosystem as JSON files.

name: CSAF providers and publishers in the BSI CSAF lister
memberRule: A CSAF provider or publisher in the aggregator.json of the BSI CSAF lister.
note: A CSAF provider publishes its advisories as CSAF 2.0 JSON at a known path. The lister of BSI names the providers and the publishers that it knows.

name: CSAF providers and publishers in the CERT@VDE aggregator
memberRule: A CSAF provider or a mirrored CSAF publisher that the CERT@VDE aggregator.json lists.
note: CERT@VDE mirrors the CSAF advisories of the makers of industrial products. Many of these makers have no other feed.

name: GCVE Numbering Authorities (GNAs)
memberRule: An organization that the GCVE directory lists as a numbering authority that assigns GCVE ids.
note: GCVE is a European numbering of vulnerabilities. Each authority assigns its own ids. The lookup of CIRCL reads the records of the authorities.

name: FIRST member teams
memberRule: An incident response or security team that is a member of FIRST. National CSIRTs are a subset.
note: The count is the number of rows of the teams API of FIRST. Not each team publishes a public feed, so the count is a top limit of the feeds.

name: Trusted Introducer directory of security teams
memberRule: A team that the Trusted Introducer directory lists, accredits or certifies.
note: The directory of the security teams of Europe. The count is not known, because the JSON download gave no total.

name: EU CSIRTs Network members
memberRule: A CSIRT that an EU Member State appoints, plus CERT-EU.
note: The teams that the member states of the EU appoint, and CERT-EU. The page has no list in a file, so the count is not known.

name: MISP default feed list
memberRule: A feed entry in defaults.json, the default feed list that MISP ships.
note: Each entry is a feed of indicators that MISP reads: lists of bad hosts, addresses and files. The feeds come from many teams.

name: EU and EEA data protection authorities
memberRule: A national supervisory authority of an EU or EEA state that sits on the European Data Protection Board.
note: Each authority publishes news and decisions about breaches of personal data. Few of them publish a feed of the breaches that they get.
